name: THR (religious holiday allowance)
authority: Permenaker 6/2016 art.7(1): a PKWTT worker whose employment ends in the thirty days before the religious holiday is owed THR; art.7(3): a PKWT that ends by its term is not. Off-boarding raises the row for an exit from 18 February to 12 March 2026 (Idulfitri 20 March, SKB 3 Menteri 2026; art.5(4) pays by 13 March, so a later leaver was paid in the run). Permenaker 6/2016 art.7: a PKWTT employee whose employment ends within thirty days before the religious holiday keeps the THR; Idulfitri 1447 H is 21 March 2026 (SKB 3 Menteri 2026, the published holiday rows), so the thirty days run from 19 February and the THR is due by 14 March (art.5(4), seven days before). the version in force in December 2025 measures a Christian or Catholic leaver against Christmas 2025 (25 December 2025; a PKWTT leaver from 25 November), not Christmas 2026. art.3(3)–(4): for a worker paid by the day (or hour) one month’s wage is the average wage received each month over the last twelve months before the holiday, or over the months worked where fewer — `employment.earned_monthly_average(12)` over the earlier payslips (basic, standing allowances, overtime, less unpaid days), a part first month counted as its share; a month of service no payslip settles is refused. the window is no longer written as dates of one year. A departure is judged against the declared departure input `thr_holiday_date` — the employee’s own religious holiday (art.1(2)) on the SKB date of its year, the first on or after the thirtieth day before the last day — so a 2027 or later leaver is measured against that year’s holiday: employed on it (the last day on or after it) is owed the THR, and a PKWTT whose last day falls within the thirty days (720 hours) before it keeps it (art.7(1)). Permenaker 6/2016 art.5(1): THR is given once a year, on the worker’s own religious holiday; SE Menaker M/3/HK.04.00/III/2026 item 7 (2 March 2026): it is paid in full and may not be paid in instalments. The band’s own amount is its calendar-year ceiling, so a second THR request in the year — an instalment or a duplicate — is refused rather than paid again. art.5(2) (signed PDF, jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/permenaker_6_2016.pdf): where the same religious holiday falls more than once in one year, THR is given for each occurrence, so the calendar-year ceiling is one THR for each published holiday of the year tagged with the worker’s religion (`entry.religious_holidays`, `jurisdiction_holidays.religion`), and never less than one (art.5(1)).

name: THR (religious holiday, in service)
authority: Permenaker 6/2016 art.2(1): a worker of one month’s continuous service or more is owed THR; art.5(1): once a year, on the worker’s own religious holiday (art.1(2): Idul Fitri for ISLAM, Natal for CHRISTIAN and CATHOLIC, Nyepi for HINDU, Waisak for BUDDHIST, Imlek for CONFUCIAN — `jurisdiction_holidays.religion`); art.5(2): each occurrence where the holiday falls twice in a year; art.5(4): paid at the latest seven days before the holiday. Raised by its schedule three weeks ahead of that day for everyone in service; a leaver in the thirty days before the holiday is settled by THR (SEPARATION, art.7). A worker with no recorded religion is owed nothing this class can date.

name: Uang pesangon (severance pay)
authority: PP 35/2021 arts.40–57 set the pesangon schedule and a cause-specific multiplier. UU 6/2023 art.157 sets the monthly wage basis: basic wage plus fixed allowances; 30 times daily wage; or the 12-month output-paid average floored at the applicable regional minimum. PP 35 art.59 replaces the schedule with the worker-employer agreement for a micro or small enterprise. PP 68/2009 art.1 angka 3 confines its final severance rates to a "orang pribadi dalam negeri"; a non-resident's is imbalan sehubungan dengan pekerjaan withheld PPh 26 at 20% of gross (UU PPh art.26(1); PMK 168/2023 arts.5(1), 12(9), 14(1)), so it counts toward PPH26 as UANG_PISAH and PKWT_COMPENSATION do.

name: Uang penghargaan masa kerja (service award)
authority: PP 35/2021 arts.40–57 set the UPMK service schedule and identify the causes that carry it. UU 6/2023 art.157 sets the monthly wage basis. PP 35 art.59 replaces the schedule with the worker-employer agreement for a micro or small enterprise. PP 68/2009 art.1 angka 3 confines its final severance rates to a "orang pribadi dalam negeri"; a non-resident's is imbalan sehubungan dengan pekerjaan withheld PPh 26 at 20% of gross (UU PPh art.26(1); PMK 168/2023 arts.5(1), 12(9), 14(1)), so it counts toward PPH26 as UANG_PISAH and PKWT_COMPENSATION do.

name: Uang kompensasi PKWT (fixed-term compensation)
authority: PP 35/2021 arts.15–17: a non-foreign fixed-term worker with at least one month of continuous service receives one month of basic wage plus fixed allowances per 12 months served, pro rata, including an early end. Article 16(6) replaces that schedule with the worker-employer agreement for a micro or small enterprise. PP 35/2021 art.15(2) pays the compensation when the PKWT ends, and PP 68/2009 art.1 angka 4 defines uang pesangon as income paid "dengan nama dan dalam bentuk apapun, sehubungan dengan berakhirnya masa kerja atau terjadi pemutusan hubungan kerja", so it carries the final PPh 21 severance rates (`PPH21_FINAL_SEVERANCE`) and leaves the TER base; a non-resident's is PPh 26. Kring Pajak (DJP, 7 June 2023) refers compensation paid in connection with the end of service to PP 68/2009 and PMK-16/PMK.03/2010.

name: Uang pisah (contract-defined separation pay)
authority: PP 35/2021 arts.49–52 and 54: the listed causes carry separation pay only where and at the amount stated in the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement. PP 68/2009 art.1 angka 4 defines uang pesangon as income paid under whatever name and in whatever form in connection with the end of service or termination, so uang pisah carries the final PPh 21 severance rates (`PPH21_FINAL_SEVERANCE`) and is outside the TER base; a non-resident's is PPh 26.

name: Employer-funded pension offset
authority: PP 35/2021 art.58: the portion of a pension benefit funded by the employer may count toward pesangon, UPMK and separation-pay obligations only where the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement provides it; the employer pays any shortfall.

name: Uang penggantian hak — travel home
authority: PP 35/2021 art.40(4)(b): on termination the worker's and family's travel back to where the worker was hired is paid (customer input: the cost entered). PP 68/2009 art.1 angka 4: uang penggantian hak is part of the final severance base.
